tools.name: get_hostel_facts
tools.description: Canonical facts about Ashraf Gents Hostel: address, phone/WhatsApp, rooms, monthly and daily stays, rates, rules, map position.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search the hostel's guides about Kalamassery and Kochi (colleges like CUSAT, NUALS and the Medical College, RCC/CCRC, workplaces, transport, services, food, festivals). Returns titles, URLs, summaries, key facts and a citation for each.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Full text of one guide as Markdown, with its sources and citation. Pass the slug or URL from search_guides.

tools.name: nearby_places
tools.description: Named places within about 1.3 km of the hostel (bus stops, schools, places of worship, clinics, fuel, shops, workplaces) and straight-line distances to major landmarks (metro stations, Medical College, RCC/CCRC, CUSAT, airport). Data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Prepares a WhatsApp message to Ashraf Gents Hostel asking whether a bed is free. Does NOT book or reserve anything; the user must send the message and the hostel confirms. Men only.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guides, get_guide, check_availability · Public sink: check_availability.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guides, get_guide, check_availability · Public sink: check_availability

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
